catalyst_text: FDA accepted the NDA for relacorilant in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. The application has a PDUFA decision date of 2026-07-11.
NDA resubmitted to FDA for Cushing syndrome
detailed_catalyst_text: The NDA for treatment of Cushing's syndrome was resubmitted to the FDA. The resubmission includes additional analyses requested by the agency and returns the program to active review. It is supported by positive data from the pivotal GRACE and Phase 3 GRADIENT studies.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated (NASDAQ:CORT)... today announced it has resubmitted its New Drug Application (NDA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for relacorilant as a treatment for patients with Cushing's syndrome. As requested by the FDA, the resubmission includes additional analyses of data included in the original NDA submission. Corcept's resubmission is based on positive data from its pivotal GRACE trial, the double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase III GRADIENT trial, relacorilant's long-term extension study and earlier-stage development data.

catalyst_text: Presented positive clinical data at scientific meeting
detailed_catalyst_text: New data from a randomized, placebo-controlled treatment phase of CATALYST were presented at a major diabetes meeting, showing significant HbA1c reduction and clinically meaningful weight and waist decreases in patients with difficult-to-control type 2 diabetes who had hypercortisolism. Numerically greater benefits were observed in participants also receiving GLP-1 agents or tirzepatide. These results support cortisol modulation as a complementary approach to improve metabolic control in this population.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated ... announced the presentation of new data from its CATALYST and MOMENTUM trials at the American Diabetes Association's 86th Scientific Sessions. ... In CATALYST's treatment phase, 136 of the patients who had been found to have hypercortisolism were randomized 2:1 to receive either Korlym or placebo for 24 weeks. Patients who received Korlym exhibited a clinically meaningful and statistically significant reduction in HbA1c (1.3 percent, p-value: <0.001). These patients also exhibited clinically meaningful reductions in body weight (5.1 kg), body mass index (1.7 kg/m2) and waist circumference (5.1 cm), compared to patients who received placebo (all nominal p-values less than 0.002). The data presented at ADA described treatment outcomes in the 71 patients in CATALYST who were taking GLP-1 receptor agonists or the GLP-1/GIP agonist tirzepatide. In this group, patients who received Korlym exhibited numerically greater benefit than the overall study population with reductions in HbA1c (1.7 percent), body weight (6.1 kg), body mass index (2.0 kg/m2) and waist circumference (6.5 cm), compared to patients who received placebo (all nominal p-values less than 0.04).

catalyst_text: FDA approval and positive Phase 3 data presented
detailed_catalyst_text: New overall survival results from the pivotal Phase 3 ROSELLA trial were presented at ASCO, showing a 35% reduction in risk of death and median OS of 16.0 vs 11.9 months in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer. The regimen also received FDA approval in 2026 for adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer, and a Marketing Authorisation Application has been submitted to the EMA. These milestones underscore clinical benefit and support broader patient access and potential international expansion.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated (NASDAQ:CORT)... today presented new overall survival data from its pivotal Phase 3 ROSELLA trial of Lifyorli (relacorilant) plus nab-paclitaxel (a taxane chemotherapy) in an oral presentation at the ASCO 2026 (American Society of Clinical Oncology) Annual Meeting. In ROSELLA, patients treated with Lifyorli combined with nab-paclitaxel experienced a 35 percent reduction in the risk of death compared to patients treated with nab-paclitaxel alone (hazard ratio (HR): 0.65; p-value: 0.0004), with a median overall survival of 16.0 months, compared to 11.9 months for patients receiving nab-paclitaxel alone. Lifyorli, in combination with nab-paclitaxel, was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in March 2026 for the treatment of adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who have received one to three prior systemic treatment regimens, at least one of which included bevacizumab. Corcept has submitted a Marketing Authorisation Application (MAA) to the European Medicines Agency (EMA) for relacorilant to treat patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

catalyst_text: Received Complete Response Letter from FDA regarding NDA
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter to the NDA for relacorilant to treat Cushing's syndrome. The letter prompted additional analyses of the NDA data, representing a regulatory setback for the program.
catalyst_text_evidence: “Following issuance of its complete response letter, the FDA asked us to conduct additional analyses of our NDA data,” said Joseph K. Belanoff, M.D., Corcept's Chief Executive Officer.

catalyst_text: Announced positive Phase 2 survival data in ALS
detailed_catalyst_text: Two-year overall survival data from the Phase 2 DAZALS study in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis showed a significant mortality reduction for patients receiving 300 mg. While the ALSFRS-R primary endpoint was not met, overall survival improved at 24 weeks and the benefit persisted to two years (HR 0.13; p<0.0001). These findings indicate a meaningful mortality benefit and support advancement of the program.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated ... announced two-year overall survival data from the Phase 2 DAZALS study of its proprietary, selective cortisol modulator dazucorilant in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Although DAZALS did not meet its primary endpoint, at the end of the 24-week treatment period patients who received 300 mg of dazucorilant daily did exhibit improved overall survival (p-value: 0.02). In the two years following the start of treatment, patients who received 300 mg of dazucorilant experienced an 87 percent reduction in the risk of death compared to patients who received placebo and did not switch to 300 mg of dazucorilant in the extension phase (hazard ratio: 0.13; p-value: < 0.0001).

catalyst_text: FDA approval and positive phase three results presented
detailed_catalyst_text: Final overall survival results from the pivotal Phase 3 ROSELLA trial in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer were presented, showing significant benefits in overall and progression-free survival with manageable safety. The regimen received U.S. FDA approval in 2026-03 for adults with platinum-resistant disease, establishing the first approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist for this setting.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated (NASDAQ:CORT) today presented final overall survival data from its pivotal Phase 3 ROSELLA trial of Lifyorli (relacorilant) combined with the chemotherapeutic agent nab-paclitaxel in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer in a late-breaking oral presentation at the Society of Gynecologic Oncology (SGO) 2026 Annual Meeting on Women's Cancer. These data were simultaneously published in The Lancet: "Overall survival with relacorilant and nab-paclitaxel in patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (ROSELLA): a phase 3 randomised controlled trial." Lifyorli, in combination with nab-paclitaxel, was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in 2026-03 for the treatment of adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who have received one to three prior systemic treatment regimens, at least one of which included bevacizumab. The ROSELLA trial met its dual primary endpoints of overall and progression-free survival, regardless of biomarker status and without an increased safety burden. Patients treated with Lifyorli in addition to nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy experienced a 35 percent reduction in the risk of death compared to patients treated with nab-paclitaxel alone (hazard ratio: 0.65; p-value: 0.0004).

catalyst_text: Received FDA approval for ovarian cancer indication
detailed_catalyst_text: The FDA approved relacorilant, in combination with nab-paclitaxel, for adults with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer who received one to three prior regimens including bevacizumab. This provides a new treatment option and represents the first approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist, supporting improved outcomes observed in the ROSELLA trial.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated (NASDAQ:CORT)... announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Lifyorli™ (relacorilant) in combination with nab-paclitaxel for the treatment of adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who have received one to three prior systemic treatment regimens, at least one of which included bevacizumab. Lifyorli is the first FDA-approved selective glucocorticoid receptor antagonist (SGRA).

catalyst_text: Positive Phase 3 met OS endpoint NDA accepted
detailed_catalyst_text: A pivotal Phase 3 study in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer met both primary endpoints, including a significant overall survival benefit and previously reported progression-free survival improvement, with no added safety burden. The NDA for this indication has been accepted and is under FDA review with a PDUFA date of 2026-07-11; an EMA MAA is also under review, underscoring regulatory momentum.
catalyst_text_evidence: Corcept Therapeutics Incorporated (NASDAQ:CORT) ... announced that ROSELLA, the company's pivotal Phase 3 trial of relacorilant plus nab-paclitaxel to treat patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, met its overall survival (OS) primary endpoint. In ROSELLA, patients treated with relacorilant in addition to nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy experienced a 35 percent reduction in the risk of death compared to patients treated with nab-paclitaxel alone (hazard ratio: 0.65; p-value: 0.0004). Corcept previously announced that ROSELLA also met its primary endpoint of improved progression-free survival, as assessed by blinded independent central review (PFS-BICR). Patients who received relacorilant in addition to nab-paclitaxel experienced a 30 percent reduction in the risk of disease progression (hazard ratio: 0.70; p-value: 0.008). Relacorilant's New Drug Application (NDA) is under review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as a treatment for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date of 2026-07-11. Relacorilant's Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer is also under review by the European Medicines Agency (EMA).

catalyst_text: Hormonal disorder therapy rejected by FDA
detailed_catalyst_text: FDA rejected its hormonal disorder therapy, representing a material regulatory setback.
